name: Pandemic

categories.label: Team won (all 4 cures discovered)
categories.hint: Win instantly when the 4th cure is discovered; lose on 8 outbreaks, no cubes left, or Player deck cannot be drawn

winCondition: Players win collectively and immediately when all four cures are discovered. They lose if the 8th outbreak occurs, a disease cube color runs out when cubes must be added, or the Player Draw Pile cannot supply required cards.

endCondition.description: Instant win on 4th cure; defeat on 8th outbreak, cube supply exhausted, or Player Draw Pile exhausted

notes: family: coop. No points. Source is a rules summary of the official rulebook, not the PDF itself (official Z-Man PDF not retrievable); verify against the rulebook. Epidemic-card count (difficulty) is not modelled.
